articles.title: China-Linked Hackers Exploit BeyondTrust Zero-Day to Take Over Remote Support Servers
articles.executive_summary: China-linked hackers exploited a zero-day vulnerability in BeyondTrust Remote Support to take over remote support servers, posing a significant risk to enterprise and government networks. The vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-102764, has a CVSS score of 9.3, indicating a critical severity.
articles.technical_breakdown: The vulnerability, an improper origin validation in an internal messaging component, was exploited by the Armory Castle group to gain unauthorized access to remote support servers. The zero-day exploit was used in late August 2026.

Implement network segmentation and isolation for remote support servers
Monitor for suspicious activity and log anomalies related to the vulnerability
